message: I was just having a conversation with a good friend last night in which she joked that she'd like a set of rubber stamps with comments in her handwriting like: "Be more specific," "Can you provide an example to support this point?" etc. When I assigned personal essays, I found myself writing the same things (like "Be more specific," "Can you provide an example to support this point?" etc.), which sort of led me to think that personal essays aren't that much less formulaic than other essay genres (and I am inclined to agree that the personal essay *is* a genre).
